title: AI items and beings
content: Has any of you experienced like an alternate version of your house that looks pretty much the same as in the physical world but with certain figurines and furniture that looks like it comes out from an AI app whenever you take a picture of a room inside your house, and the app modifies the things inside your room? Because I have encountered that multiple times and sometimes the AI items kinda duplicates itself next to me. It's weird, but it feels like an alternate version of your house is a part of Mall World with added AI things inside of it.
